package main import ( "context" "github.com/vuka-lang/ui/v2" ) // Counter is a live component. type Counter struct { ui.Live Start int n int } func (c *Counter) Inc() { c.n++ } // Add is an event taking an argument: onClick={Add(2)}. func (c *Counter) Add(n int) { c.n += n } // resets counts the Reset events run. var resets int // Reset is an event taking the event's context and failing with an error: // onClick={Reset(ctx, 0)} runs on the click, never as the counter renders. func (c *Counter) Reset(ctx context.Context, to int) error { resets++ c.n = to return ctx.Err() }
{Start + n}
